_why: Starting values for the decision-model setup page. They live here, not in source, because npm run verify refuses a hardcoded endpoint in src/ or scripts/ — and because a value without its provenance is a value nobody can re-check.

JEV_BASE_URL.source: TypeSafe AI API reference: every request is a POST here, authenticated with a Bearer token. https://docs.typesafe.ai/api

JEV_MODEL.source: TypeSafe's flagship decision model, as named in the same reference.

keys.source: Where the API reference and key management live.
